full_judgment:
In this Rule arising out of a suit for declaration of title and confirmation of possession the plaintiff-opposite party's suit was dismissed by the trial court. The plaintiff claimed the suit land through one Mongal Das who according to the plaintiff was adopted by Fulkumari and her husband Bijoy Lal. The defendant-Petitioner contended that Mongal Das could not be adopted because he was an orphan. Also there was no ceremony. The defendant petitioners claimed the suit land through the reversioners of Bijoylal who died childless. The trial Court upheld the contention of the defendant petitioners. The appellate Court below, concurring with the finding of the trial court that Mongal Das was an orphan, nevertheless upheld the adoption upon the doctrine of factum valet and also holding that no ceremony was necessary. It decree the suit. 

 There is no evidence that in Bangladesh there is a custom of adoption of an orphan amongst the Hindus. The judgment and decree of the appellate Court below therefore cannot be sustained. 

 In the result the Rule is made absolute without any order as to costs. The judgment and decree of the appellate Court below are set aside and those of the trial Court are affirmed.
